description: Only telescopes whose pointing accuracy is strictly greater than 4.86 are included.

b.request: Inner join telescopes to observatories on observstation, keep only telescopes with pointaccarc strictly greater than 4.86, group by observatory station and weathprofile, compute per group the average bandusagepct (ignoring NULLs) and the telescope count, then return one row with the unrounded average of the group averages (ignoring NULL group averages) and the unrounded average of the group counts.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g

a.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes whose pointing accuracy (`pointaccarc`) is strictly greater than 4.86, group them by observatory station and weather profile (`weathprofile`). For each group, find the average bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`, ignoring missing values) and the number of telescopes. Then return a single row with the average of those group averages (ignoring missing ones) and the average of those group counts, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_avg_bandusage, AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) g

c.request: Matching each telescope to its observatory by `observstation` (dropping telescopes with no matching observatory) and keeping only telescopes on the high side of a 4.86 cutoff for pointing accuracy (`pointaccarc`), group them by observatory station and weather profile (`weathprofile`). For each group, find the average bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`, ignoring missing values) and the number of telescopes. Then return a single row with the average of those group averages (ignoring missing ones) and the average of those group counts, unrounded. Only telescopes whose pointing accuracy is strictly greater than 4.86 are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandwidth, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) g
